## About the Company

Merchant Savvy is a division of VUBO Ltd (Company Number 09017066), based in the UK. It is an independent comparison and advice service for businesses that take card payments. Its logo: ![](images/merchant-savvy-purple.svg). Website: https://www.merchantsavvy.co.uk

Address: Spaces, 9 Greyfriars Rd, Reading, RG1 1NU.

Copyright notice: © All rights reserved 2021.

## Main Message

Headline: Payment Processing Made Simple (& Cheaper)

Key points:
- The service helps businesses secure preferential rates and cut their card processing costs.
- It gives access to 90% of the UK's leading acquiring banks.
- It recommends the best route for each business and explains the reasoning.
- There are no sales agents and no multiple call centres, only a single source of independent advice.

Payment brand logos: ![](images/msuk-payment-logos-olsaj0e9fmj5ffxbeu1x31du81g362lakwdto6enlg.png)

## Payment Processing

Businesses can compare merchant accounts and payment processors to find the best fit for taking card payments in person, by phone or online.

Topics covered (each has its own page):
- Merchant Account Providers: /best-uk-merchant-accounts-card-payment-services/ (full URL: https://www.merchantsavvy.co.uk/best-uk-merchant-accounts-card-payment-services/)
- Card Readers & Machines (also called Card Machines): /credit-card-machines-readers/ (https://www.merchantsavvy.co.uk/credit-card-machines-readers/)
- Credit Card Processing Fees (a guide to card processing fees): /credit-card-processing-fees/ (https://www.merchantsavvy.co.uk/credit-card-processing-fees/)
- High Risk Merchant Accounts: /high-risk-merchant-accounts/ (https://www.merchantsavvy.co.uk/high-risk-merchant-accounts/)
- Payment Gateways: /payment-gateways/ (https://www.merchantsavvy.co.uk/payment-gateways/)
- Online Payment Systems: /online-payment-systems/ (https://www.merchantsavvy.co.uk/online-payment-systems/)
- EPOS Systems (also listed as EPOS): /epos-systems/ (https://www.merchantsavvy.co.uk/epos-systems/)
- Virtual Terminals: /virtual-terminals/ (https://www.merchantsavvy.co.uk/virtual-terminals/)
- Recurring Payments (direct debit): https://www.merchantsavvy.co.uk/direct-debit-recurring-payments/
- eCommerce Platforms: https://www.merchantsavvy.co.uk/ecommerce-platforms-for-uk-businesses/
- Quotes: https://www.merchantsavvy.co.uk/quotes/

## Finance & Banking

Banking and finance options for both start-ups and established businesses that accept card payments.

Topics covered:
- Merchant Cash Advance: /business-finance/merchant-cash-advance/
- Start Up Loans: /business-loans/start-up-loans/
- Business Credit Cards: /business-credit-cards/
- Business Bank Accounts: /best-business-bank-accounts/
- Sole Trader Bank Accounts: /best-business-bank-accounts/sole-trader-bank-accounts/
- Charity & Community Bank Accounts: /best-business-bank-accounts/charity-community-bank-accounts/

## Research & Statistics

Data and statistics pages:
- UK SMEs: /uk-sme-data-stats-charts/ ![](images/charts.jpg)
- Mobile Payments: /mobile-payment-stats-trends/
- Mobile Ecommerce: /mobile-ecommerce-statistics/
- Remote Working: /remote-working-statistics/
- Payment Fraud: /payment-fraud-statistics/ ![](images/payment-fraud-stats.jpg)

## Legal Pages

- Privacy Policy: /privacy-policy/
- Terms Of Use: /terms-use/

Accepted payment types: ![](images/payment-types.png)

To view it, open `index.html` in a browser.
